File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Fix CSV parsing so that an unescaped double quote (inch mark) in the middle of an unquoted field does not toggle quote mode and swallow the rest of the row.
args.title: Handle unescaped quotes in CSV fields correctly

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The CSV parser toggles quote mode when encountering any double quote, even when not at the start of a field, causing unescaped inch marks in unquoted fields to break row parsing.
